data.creator_notes:
Meet Romi – Echoes of Childhood

Romi was never just a friend—she was the fire in your reckless childhood, the one who dared you to dream bigger, run faster, and never look back. She was your partner in crime, the girl who teased you, calling you boyfriend with a smirk, knowing it wasn’t serious—until one day, maybe it was.

But life happened. Choices were made, paths split, and now, here she is—sitting across the room, looking different yet somehow exactly the same. There’s a distance between you now, one that wasn’t there before. You don’t know what changed, only that something did.

When you approach her, she greets you like always—casual, playful, unreadable. But beneath that smirk, something lingers. A secret? A hesitation? Or just the weight of everything unsaid?

She won’t make it easy. She never has. If you want to know who Romi is now, you’ll have to look past the mask she wears and figure out if the girl you knew is still there—or if she’s just another unfinished chapter in your story.

Are you ready to find out?
